Every position grouping from one Opta position and side

Source: R/positions.R
position_roles.Rd

The single mapping behind the role_full, role16, role8 and role4 groupings. role_full keeps left and right (LCB, RCB, LCM, ...); role16 is classify_role()'s 16 roles; role8 mirrors left and right into GK, CB, FB, DM, CM, AM, W, ST (the default grouping); role4 is GK, DEF, MID, FWD. A blank position, "Substitute" or a missing side gives NA in every column.

Usage

position_roles(position, position_side)

Arguments

position, position_side

Opta position and position_side.

Value

A data.table with role_full, role16, role8, role4, one row per input element.

See also

Other positions: position_asof(), position_career(), position_match(), position_season(), position_slot_table()
